services.name: Fly-in Fishing
services.desc: The scene is spectacular. Fishing that is fun for every age. No combat fishing here. The most commonly caught fish are grayling and rainbow trout. We keep a constant eye on lakes where our guests have been most successful in catching fish. These lakes are full of grayling. It’s fun for every age - kids too. You'll rarely see other people at the lake where you are flown to - no combat fishing here. Not to mention spectacular scenery. Experience remote lake and river fishing with the convenience and comfort of professional guide by your side. blurb: Guests can explore Alaska from the air with flight-seeing tours ranging from 30 to 90 minutes, fly-in fishing for grayling and rainbow trout, hunting, or stay overnight at USFS cabins accessible by float plane. The operation is based on Trail Lake in Moose Pass, Alaska, providing quick access to remote lakes and scenic mountain and glacier views.
